What is Evergreen Theme?

thumb|right|A Ninjago set released in the 2019 Legacy subtheme An Evergreen Theme is a theme that has continuous success throughout many years and becomes a staple of LEGO's Brand. City, Star Wars, and Ninjago are all referred to as evergreen themes.
